## DPStyleARWebLive class

This is the core class for controlling StyleAR virtual try-on. You need to render the item using the information provided by this class for StyleAR virtual try-on.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class DPStyleARWebLive 
```

This method finalizes the rendering pass by applying all StyleAR outputs (item rendering and mask ROI) so the latest virtual try-on result is reflected in the current frame.

</td><td>


</td><td>

Start the camera and image processing modules for StyleAR virtual try-on. This method prepares both camera capture and frame processing subsystems, but does not immediately grab camera frames or process images. The actual camera frame capture via grab() and frame processing via process() are triggered by the SDK user when calling those methods. This design allows developers to control the timing and frequency of capture and processing operations.
